SECTION A: Multiple Choice Questions (1 Mark Each)

Q1. Which of the following treaties recognised Greece as an independent nation?  
(A) Treaty of Vienna 1815  
(B) Treaty of Constantinople 1832  
(C) Treaty of Versailles 1919  
(D) Treaty of Lausanne 1923

Answer / Solution:
Which of the following treaties recognised Greece as an independent nation? 
(B) Treaty of Constantinople 1832 
Reasoning: The Treaty of Constantinople of 1832 recognized Greece as an 
independent nation.
